title: What happens if I don't pay my dues on time?

nodes.label: Active
nodes.detail: Member is in good standing with full access to benefits, journals, and member rates.

nodes.label: Renewal due
nodes.detail: Annual renewal invoice is sent November 1 and due by December 31.

nodes.label: Renewed
nodes.detail: Dues paid on time or during the grace period; membership continues uninterrupted.

nodes.label: Grace period
nodes.detail: From January 1 through March 1, all member benefits remain active with no late fee.

nodes.label: Lapsed
nodes.detail: After 60 days unpaid, member benefits pause until dues and a $25 reinstatement fee are paid.

nodes.label: Reinstated
nodes.detail: Paying overdue dues plus the $25 fee restores active status and preserves join-date tenure.

nodes.label: Removed
nodes.detail: Accounts unpaid for 12 months leave the active roster and require a new application.

cards.title: Paying late within 60 days
cards.body: Members keep every benefit for 60 days after January 1 with no late fee.

cards.title: After 60 days
cards.body: Benefits pause until dues and a $25 fee are paid; after 12 months the record is removed.
